text:
alex: CI red on my PR after merge: job https://ci.internal/redwood/4821 failed with flaky test `serve_retry_ordering::test_interleaved_retries`

maria: ugh, seen that one earlier this week in canary. failing only on p95 windows.

sam: can you paste the failing log lines?

alex: here — looks timing-y:```
thread_id=23 wait_ms=12 -> acquired
thread_id=17 wait_ms=0 -> retry kicked
thread_id=23 got response seq=5
thread_id=17 got response seq=4
assert_eq!(seq_order, [4,5]) failed
```

jin: hmm order flipped. might be nondet preemption in the retry path. did you run `cargo test --release -p runtime --test serve_retry_ordering -- --nocapture` locally?

alex: yeah ran locally 10x, couldn't repro. CI repro rate ~30% on this job.

maria: can we rerun the job first? maybe transient infra. @ci-bot please rerun job 4821 :pray:

ci-bot: re-run requested for job 4821 by maria — queued on runner pool `gpu-ci-2`

qa-bot: note: marking flaky candidate (historical failure rate 27% last 7 days)

sam: if rerun still fails, we should bisect. alex could you kick off a bisect on that test across the last 50 commits? we might narrow to a scheduler change.

alex: will do. running `./scripts/ci-bisect --test serve_retry_ordering --since HEAD~50` now. posting progress...

maria: also pinging @jin to eyeball the retry backoff change landed in PR #397. that touched the retry timer jitter logic.

jin: noted — I changed backoff math but kept deterministic tests in mind. one thought: the test uses a tight sleep of 1ms which can be noisy on busy runners. maybe increase to 5ms or use a test-only deterministic scheduler.

sam: agree. if bisect points to that PR we can either add a test harness hook or relax timing window. prefer harness.

alex: bisect run started, first batch (10 commits) queued. will update with culprit commit if found.

ci-bot: rerun job 4821 completed — status: failed (same test). logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/4821/attempt/2

maria: ok failing on rerun too. thanks alex for bisect.

alex: bisect found likely bad commit: 2023f9a — touches scheduler::timers and retry.rs. opening draft PR to add deterministic test hook and bump sleep to 5ms in the meantime.

jin: thanks. if you can add a feature-flag-only deterministic scheduler that the test enables, we avoid masking real flakes.

sam: assign me for review on the draft once ready. also let's add a quick flaky test ticket with labels `ci:red` `flaky` and link both PR and bisect results.

alex: created PR #452 (draft) + issue FLK-128. linking here: PR https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/452, issue https://issues.internal/redwood/FLK-128

maria: nice. leaving a reaction and will follow up tomorrow AM after infra checks. :thumbsup:

jin: drops a quick patch to test harness in the PR — will try to make scheduler injectable without breaking prod builds.

sam: once PR lands, we should monitor CI flaky rate for this test for a week and then consider backport to stable branches if noise persists.

alex: thanks all — will keep thread updated.
